principle_violations.reason: The PaymentProcessor interface requires all implementations to implement auth_sms, even if certain implementations, like CreditPaymentProcessor, do not need or cannot provide this functionality.
principle_violations.suggestion: Refactor the PaymentProcessor interface to separate authentication responsibilities from payment processing responsibilities. Create a separate interface for SMS authentication and let the DebitPaymentProcessor implement it, but not the CreditPaymentProcessor.

principle_violations.reason: The implementation of the method auth_sms in the CreditPaymentProcessor class raises an exception, which may lead to unexpected behaviors if a client expects auth_sms to work among all payment processors.
principle_violations.suggestion: Adapt the system to either handle or remove the auth_sms method from classes that do not support it, and ensure appropriate checks or interface segregation to prevent misuse.
